messages:
maria: quick follow-up on the kvcache stripe -> async-demote interaction. observed hotspots when multiple stripes try to demote overlapping kv ranges at once; host-staging fragmentation spikes and we see transient OOMs on p99. i sketched a small proposal below for a DemoteManager that owns per-stripe queues + backpressure tokens.

vlad: can you paste the repro logs? i remember seeing an OOM during the big batch test on 3/14 but assumed it was batching config.

maria: repro attached in thread run: small micro-bench with 64 stripes, 8 concurrent writers hitting overlapping keys. the sequence is: cache eviction triggers demote from stripe owner -> async demote submits pages -> allocator grabs host staging pages per-chunk. hotspots happen because allocator gets many small sparse allocations from same region which prevents compaction.

olivia: +1 on reducing small scatter demotes. one idea: coalesce demotes per-stripe into larger contiguous demote ops (if kv ranges contiguous) so host allocator sees larger contiguous runs and can place into slab-friendly segments. less fragmentation. :thinking_face:

ajohnson: how does that interact with current residency accounting? if we coalesce we need to ensure we don't double-count in-flight tokens or block eviction threads too long. race window where stripe A thinks range is demoted but coalesce merged with stripe B; need clear handoff.

maria: agreed. my proposal: lightweight DemoteManager with two primitives: submitDemote(stripe_id, kv_range, priority) and requestBackpressure(stripe_id) -> token which the allocator grants/denies. DemoteManager coalesces contiguous ranges within a stripe for a short coalesce window (10-20ms). if coalesce wins, it returns a coalesced batch to allocator. pseudo: ```
// DemoteManager (sketch)
submitDemote(stripe_id, range) -> demote_id
tryCoalesce(stripe_id) -> batch(range[])
requestBackpressure(stripe_id) -> token | null
completeDemote(demote_id, stats)
```

sam: what about cross-stripe coalescing? sometimes adjacent keys live in different stripes because hashing boundary misaligns. coalescing across stripes could help but complicates ownership. maybe do cross-stripe only if both stripes agree (two-phase fast handshake).

vlad: cross-stripe + handshake sounds costly but maybe optional. also want to call out compaction: if allocator exposes a 'hintable' API where demote provides "preferred slab affinity" we could reduce fragmentation later. e.g., allocator.hint_affinity(range, affinity_id) before allocation.

ajohnson: that hint_affinity needs safety: if affinity reserved but never filled we leak reservations. require TTL or lease tokens. also need metrics: per-stripe demote_count, coalesce_rate, host_fragmentation_index.

maria: yep, metrics included in proposal. quick bench numbers from my local run (64 stripes, 1M ops, compare naive demote vs per-stripe coalescing + affinity hint):
```
naive-demote: host-frag-index=0.78, p99-latency=42ms, avg-host-allocs-per-demote=6.8
per-stripe-coalesce+affinity: host-frag-index=0.34, p99-latency=36ms, avg-host-allocs-per-demote=1.9
cross-stripe-coalesce (opt-in handshake): host-frag-index=0.29, p99-latency=38ms
```

olivia: those numbers look promising. p99 improves and frag index halves. what's the downside? added complexity + a short coalesce delay could worsen tail if unlucky.

maria: correct tradeoffs: added queueing latency for coalesce window, extra API surface (DemoteManager, affinity hints, backpressure tokens), and handshake cost for cross-stripe. but we avoid heavy compaction cycles and reduce OOM spikes.

ajohnson: +1 on telemetry first. can we ship DemoteManager as an opt-in runtime flag behind a feature gate? start with per-stripe coalesce and affinity hints. no cross-stripe handshake initially.

ci-bot: build/2489 failed on infra-tests/mem-frag-sim (flaky). @maria could you re-run the frag sim with the new allocator branch?

maria: will re-run. action items:
- maria: implement DemoteManager PoC (per-stripe coalesce + affinity hint) behind feature flag (ETA 2w)
- vlad: add fragmentation telemetry gauges + host-frag-index calc (ETA 1w)
- ajohnson: review accounting/race windows and token lease semantics (ETA 1w)
- olivia: help design coalesce heuristics (contiguity threshold, time window)

maria: ping me if you want to pair on the PoC. I'll dump the frag sim logs and a little harness repo in the PR. thanks all :heart:
